name: helpdesk-schema-repair
description: Helpdesk schema repair — PostgreSQL schema that implements the ER diagram, verified with pgTAP.

scripts.db:reset: psql -c "DROP DATABASE IF EXISTS helpdesk_test" && psql -c "CREATE DATABASE helpdesk_test" && psql -d helpdesk_test -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f migrations/001_initial_schema.sql && psql -d helpdesk_test -c "CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS pgtap"
